summary: In this session of Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter), Sheikh Ali Mashhour continues the detailed study of this comprehensive work by Ibn al-Qayyim on the life and teachings of Prophet Muhammad. The lecture focuses on the prophecies and miracles mentioned in the text, particularly emphasizing the prophecy about people questioning the divine and allowing their minds unbounded freedom in philosophical inquiry to the point of questioning Allah's own existence. The Sheikh explains how this was not a common mentality during the Prophet's time and demonstrates its relevance to modern times. He also discusses the flawed logic of intercession worship practiced by pre-Islamic Arabs and compares earthly kingship to Allah's perfect, all-encompassing sovereignty.
suggested_title: The Prophecies of Prophet Muhammad: Unbounded Minds and Questioning the Divine - Zadul-Ma'ad Part 141
catchy_title: When Minds Know No Boundaries: Prophet's Warning About Questioning Allah
